title: Product information and care
required_reference_topics: Product/service specifications and approved enquiry procedure.
Independent variant-specific specifications and any current inventory/price records.

check_conditions.procedure.information: Identify the correct product, brand and variant and use the matching specification/care enquiry branch. Check any product identifier or variant needed by that reference. Do not require account identity for a public enquiry unless an eligible rule requires it.
check_conditions.procedure.actions: Identify the correct product, brand and variant and use the matching specification/care enquiry branch. Look up the matching specifications, care instructions or stock information; perform a purchase only when separately requested and authorised. Compare the recorded agreed operation here; required verification/eligibility/permission relationships remain in procedure.order_permission, and factual policy claims require independent eligible support in Answer support.
check_conditions.procedure.order_permission: Check any product identifier or variant needed by that reference. Do not require account identity for a public enquiry unless an eligible rule requires it. Apply any documented lookup order or purchase permission only when that branch requires it.
check_conditions.completeness: Recognise every asked feature, size, material, colour, care or warranty question. Answer each requested feature separately and keep any later purchase request separate.
check_conditions.completeness.promises_next_steps: Account for the requested information or a supported limit; a purchase promise is not purchase completion. Explain remaining information sources or customer steps without inventing an unnecessary hand-off.
check_conditions.communication-style: Use specific product features and understandable care steps.
check_conditions.answer-support: Product specifications, care instructions, stock records, warranty terms and price references for the exact variant.
